delegate-to-the-house.note: The District elects a nonvoting Delegate to the House of Representatives (the words of D.C. Code sec. 1-123(d)(2)).

state-board-of-education-at-large.note: The State Board of Education is elected on a nonpartisan basis (D.C. Code sec. 38-2651(f)).

united-states-representative-statehood.note: An office of the District, not a seat in the United States House: D.C. Code sec. 1-123(d) provides for the election of a Senator and a Representative 'from the new state' under the statehood initiative. The District's member of the House is its Delegate.

united-states-senator-statehood.note: An office of the District, not a seat in the United States Senate: D.C. Code sec. 1-123(d) provides for the election of a Senator and a Representative 'from the new state' under the statehood initiative.

state-board-of-education-ward-8.note: The State Board of Education is elected on a nonpartisan basis (D.C. Code sec. 38-2651(f)).

state-board-of-education-ward-4.note: The State Board of Education is elected on a nonpartisan basis (D.C. Code sec. 38-2651(f)).

state-board-of-education-ward-2.note: The State Board of Education is elected on a nonpartisan basis (D.C. Code sec. 38-2651(f)).

council-at-large.note: Voters chose two members: the Council has four at-large members with four-year terms, two of whose seats are filled at each general election (D.C. Code sec. 1-204.01(b)(1) and (4): four-year terms, staggered from the first election). The results site marks only the first as elected; the second is marked here because the certified figures settle it.
